_meta.spelling_policy: English spellings follow the Macross Wiki (macross.fandom.com) article title, or the infobox 'english' field where the wiki contradicts itself. Japanese names are given given-name-first in English. Variants in 'avoid' must not appear in the translation; the proofreading script replaces them with 'en'.

fields.en: Canonical English spelling to use in the translation
fields.ja: Japanese name as written in Japanese media (in-game form when known)
fields.aliases: Other legitimate names, callsigns or nicknames that may appear in dialogue
fields.avoid: Wrong or non-canonical romanizations that must be replaced with 'en'
fields.gender: From the wiki. Never infer gender from a name
fields.in_game: Role in Macross Ultimate Frontier (from ja.wikipedia game article): pilot = playable pilot, sub = sub-pilot/support only, npc = appears but not playable
fields.status: verified = English spelling and facts taken from the wiki page; needs_check = conflicting or thin sources, see notes

_meta.ja_caveat: 'ja' is confirmed from ja.wikipedia for every character with an in_game role of pilot/sub. For the others it is the usual series spelling and must be checked against the extracted game text.
_meta.game_source: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/マクロスアルティメットフロンティア

characters.position: Pilot, New U.N. Spacy Special Forces 'Moon Island Platoon'
characters.personality: High-spirited and earnest; hides self-doubt behind a confident front that can tip into cockiness. Loves training.
characters.notes: Was the unnamed 'Pilot Male A' in Ace Frontier. The player can rename this character, so dialogue may use a name placeholder instead.

characters.personality: From an elite military family. Charming, down-to-earth and caring, which men often misread as interest.
characters.notes: Was 'Pilot Female A' in Ace Frontier. Renamable by the player.

characters.ja: ゲイリー・マードック
characters.position: Pilot and commander, Moon Island Platoon
characters.personality: Veteran of many war zones. Likable, rough-spoken, a big-brother type.
characters.notes: Was 'Pilot Male B' in Ace Frontier. Renamable. Rough speech: keep it casual and blunt in English.

characters.position: Pilot and second-in-command, Moon Island Platoon
characters.personality: Cool beauty, strict and demanding, but praises people who meet her standards. Raised by a mercenary father; rough-edged but highly skilled.
characters.notes: Was 'Pilot Female B' in Ace Frontier. Renamable.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/マクロスエースフロンティア

characters.position: Pilot, Moon Island Platoon (originally enlisted as maintenance crew)
characters.personality: Energetic machine-lover who tinkers whether allowed or not. Big appetite. Speaks in an old-fashioned style that makes her sound like an old man. Superstitious about pilot jinxes.
characters.notes: Old-man speech style is a character trait: render it with old-fashioned English diction, not standard teen speech.

characters.ja: ルイス・フェルナンド
characters.personality: Long-haired, mustached passionate type who loves the sky; burning, almost limitless passion for life.
Cheerful, tries her hardest at everything. Self-conscious about looking young; wants to be cool and mature like Claire.

characters.ja: クレア・スタンフォード
characters.personality: Big-sister figure who looks after juniors. Frank to the point of cruelty with some pilots on the job; has a playful side and dotes on Pinon.
Serious, calm analyst with an unreadable face that gets him mistaken for cold. Explains things in long, detailed lectures.

characters.position: CIC operator, Moon Island Platoon (youngest ever to enlist, age 16)
characters.personality: Hates being treated like a child. Talks down to pilots in a grown-up tone and gets foul-mouthed under stress.
characters.notes: Foul mouth is intentional: do not soften.

characters.position: Second Lieutenant, U.N. Forces VF pilot (later Skull Squadron)

characters.personality: Devout and serious guardian of the island's traditions; distrustful of outsiders and their technology at first.
